 Most recent Most popular Post published at 43 mins 43 mins 
 England 1-0 Croatia 
 Declan Rice shakes his head as he concedes a corner just a couple of minutes before the break.
 Conceding a goal now would not be ideal.
 25 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:28 GMT 20:28 GMT 
 Czech Republic 0-1 Spain 
 Elsewhere, Alex Baena has just put Spain ahead against the Czech Republic.
 As it stands England could head to Madrid on Sunday with the chance to top the group, if they can beat the world champions.
 57 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:27 GMT 20:27 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Croatia are much improved, and England have done well to find a way through their midfield. "Big" Dan Burn has been very impressive as well, he deserves more opportunities with England after his heroics in that Mexico game.
 Alex, Witham 
 Image source, PA Media 
 130 53 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 41 mins 41 mins 
 England 1-0 Croatia 
 Trent Alexander-Arnold unleashes a powerful shot from distance but it flies over the bar.
 57 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:26 GMT 20:26 GMT 
 England 1-0 Croatia 
 Alex Howell 
BBC Sport England reporter at Wembley 
 After England went ahead they played with more promise but the game has settled down now. 
 It's gone a bit flat inside the stadium and the odd paper aeroplane has been thrown from supporters looking for entertainment. 
 50 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Croatia are there for the taking' published at 20:26 GMT 20:26 GMT 
 England 1-0 Croatia 
 Paul Robinson 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Wembley 
 Croatia are a team that are there for the taking. England, to their detriment, are slowing the ball down but if they want to step on the gas, they could go and get two more before half-time.
 78 36 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 36 mins 36 mins 
 England 1-0 Croatia 
 It's been better from England and they will be pleased to have the goal under their belt.
 But it's not exactly scintillating stuff, to be honest.
 Image source, Reuters 
 85 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 33 mins 33 mins 
 England 1-0 Croatia 
 Mateo Kovacic hits one from distance but it's straight at Jordan Pickford.
 We have seen the Manchester City midfielder score those before.
 35 61 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:18 GMT 20:18 GMT 
 England 1-0 Croatia 
 Paul Robinson 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Wembley 
 Excellent from England getting the wide players involved. 
 Lewis Hall and Anthony Gordon combine and that's a relationship that really needs to flourish for England. 
 167 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 29 mins 29 mins 
 England 1-0 Croatia 
 The ball comes to Lewis Hall in the middle of the penalty box but his touch is heavy and he's left chasing the ball.
 England do manage to win a corner, though.
 79 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:15 GMT 20:15 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Once again, a brilliant ball from Kane gets the goal.
 Aarav, London 
 355 78 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 28 mins 28 mins 
 England 1-0 Croatia 
 Croatia had started the game well but a nice move from England undid them and they were left scrambling in front of goal.
 132 28 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:13 GMT 20:13 GMT 
 England 1-0 Croatia 
 Rob Green 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Wembley 
 England have barely had to get out of second gear to take the lead.
 134 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:13 GMT 20:13 GMT 
 England 1-0 Croatia 
 Alex Howell 
BBC Sport England reporter at Wembley 
 It's a really nicely worked goal. 
 Kane drops deep as he so often does, finds Bellingham and Rogers bundles in. 
 That's three of the front four combining for that goal and it gives England the lead. 
 Bellingham wheels away with his arms in the air after his assist. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 250 37 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Well-worked goal' published at 20:12 GMT 20:12 GMT 
 England 1-0 Croatia 
 Paul Robinson 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Wembley 
 Those are the types of positions Jude Bellingham picks up. He just ghosts in at the back post.
 He plays it first time on the volley and Morgan Rogers doesn't hit it in cleanly but he bounces it into the ground. 
 It's a well-worked goal but not the cleanest.
 174 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - England 1-0 Croatia published at 20:10 GMT 20:10 GMT 
 Morgan Rogers (24 mins) 
 Well England have had a little bit of luck getting the opener but they will take it!
 Harry Kane delivers a nice ball to the back post and it's knocked back across goal by Jude Bellingham for Morgan Rogers .
 It's a bit of a scramble between him and Josko Gvardiol but the Chelsea man has the last touch to bundle over the line and Dominik Livakovic can't get back quick enough.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 1635 120 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Alexander-Arnold has freedom' published at 20:09 GMT 20:09 GMT 
 England 0-0 Croatia 
 Rob Green 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Wembley 
 I think given the game and opposition on Sunday you feel there will be more of a defender in there against Spain.
 Trent Alexander-Arnold has more freedom today and is playing as a right-back when defending but certainly isn't when England attack. 
 134 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 22 mins 22 mins 
 England 0-0 Croatia 
 Good run down the left-hand side by Josko Gvardiol.
 It comes to Josip Misic and he gets a shot away from range but drags it wide. This has been night and day compared to the away leg.
 31 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:07 GMT 20:07 GMT 
 England 0-0 Croatia 
 Rob Green 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Wembley 
 It looks like England's best route to goal is down that right-hand side with Trent Alexander-Arnold so far.
 136 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19 mins 19 mins 
 England 0-0 Croatia 
 Better from England as Trent Alexander-Arnold has a crack from the edge of the box. His effort is blocked behind for a corner but it was a good strike.
